text_block_list.text:
The day of the Chunichi Shimbun Hai. While 
Nice Nature waits for her turn in the 
waiting room, Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro 
Ryan come to visit.

They explained that they had seen Nice 
Nature looking unwell a few days prior, 
and came by to check on her out of 
concern.

Nice Nature let the two know she had 
properly bounced back, before heading off 
to the race.
